evidence: Source-level design passes. (1) Global rule: functional/prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review', plus line 13 'A blank or static shell ... gives every binary criterion 0' and a gate requiring a real UI create + independent-context Observer readback (functional/prompt.md:11; gates/constraints/judge.toml:23), so a blank, static, login-only or browser-only app scores 0 on every row. (2) Render gate pairs the negative with its control: gates/render/judge.toml:23 'An incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out ... the correct password ... then signs in', reinforced by gates/render/prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control.' (3) Every functional row with a refuse/hide/absent/unchanged leg names its control inside the criterion: hro_job_open:29 ('the successful opening is the control'), hro_add_email_rules:47 ('same address on a different job is accepted (the control)'), hro_move_one_stage:56 (one-stage forward/back must work), hro_reject_reason:83 (reason-ful rejection), hro_reject_hired:92 ('A rejection of a non-hired card is the control'), hro_reopen:101 (reopen to own stage), hro_interview_full:110 ('the two cards that entered Interview are the control'), hro_undo_full:128 ('same-kind control'), hro_mgr_early_refused:155 ('their late-stage moves are the control'; Rafael's open/add successes are the same-kind control under prompt.md:13), hro_mgr_other_job:164, hro_observer_readonly:173 ('Rafael's identical successful requests are the control'), hro_candidate_no_staff:182 (explicit candidate-data and staff controls with 'makes this row 0'), hro_anonymous:191 ('A signed-in success of each is the control'), hro_stale_refused:200, hro_bulk_all_or_none:218, hro_bulk_places:227, hro_undo_conflict:245 ('same-kind control'), hro_undo_once:254, hro_activity_refusals:272 ('The successful actions' lines are the control'), hro_notes:281, hro_msg_compose:308 ('A normal send is the control'), hro_thread_access:362 (recruiters/Bill write, Observer reads), hro_candidate_private:389 (own data control + 'receives none of its own data is 0' + Rafael's identical read control), hro_seen:353 (not-seen legs paired with later seen), hro_unread_counts:335 / hro_unread_scrolled_up:344 (non-increase legs paired with rise/notice), hro_restart:407 ('not loaded again' paired with all records surviving). Polish: hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread make the row 0 if the update never arrives; hro_pol_failed_send requires the retry to send once; hro_pol_session_resume names 'the positive control' and pairs Mei's empty boxes with Rafael's drafts surviving. Visual rows are likert craft with no negative legs. Broken-app probe: an app that refuses every write passes no refusal row because each pairs with a same-kind success; an app that never shows Activity fails hro_activity_refusals' control; an app with no seen marker fails hro_seen's later leg; a candidate login that returns nothing is explicitly 0 in hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_candidate_private. Conforming-alternative probe: apps that hide refused controls are not penalised (functional/prompt.md:23 'Whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice'; replay with current version value, prompt.md:17), so the controls do not demand a specific UI. Minor note (not a defect): hro_refused_put_back:137 does not name its control inline, but its precondition 'the full-Interview move' (protocol L: A and B successfully entered Interview) plus prompt.md:13 supplies it; an app refusing all Interview entries cannot produce a full Interview. Risk=true only because runtime discrimination is unmeasured: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'reward discrimination/ranking and full configured grading ... are absent', so it is not measured that the configured judge actually enforces these controls on a broken app.
